claims.text: Reviewers consistently praise the beautiful, mirror-like chrome finish and color-shifting effect.
Many note that a little goes a long way and the product is easy to apply smoothly.
Several reviewers find it pricey or are surprised by the small quantity, though many still consider it worth the cost.
Reviewers say it outperforms other brands they've tried and works reliably every time.
Some mention that results depend on using the proper non-wipe top coat.
